commit_scope: Prove endpoint_grocery_amount.fk four-way (go, rust, ts, c-bootstrapped fkwu) and move the grocery ledger's sheet credential from environment variables onto the one config carrier.

commands: cd api && python -m pytest tests/test_grocery_ledger.py tests/test_household_service_board.py -q
local_validation.summary: fkwu built from the pinned kernel (87e6b00) c-bootstrap and gated on the three bootstrap grounds (42 / 55 / [1, 2.5, [3, 4]]). 25 flow tests pass against that live kernel — the grocery ledger plus the household board whose place cells it reuses.

four_way_validation.band: endpoint_grocery_amount.fk — thousands to whole rupiah, integer-only
four_way_validation.summary: fourth arm: 9 case(s) four-way, 0 divergent. No unsupported op — the band uses only add/sub/mul/div/lt and recursion.
four_way_validation.harness_note: A first pass reported three fkwu divergences. They were an artifact of the harness rewriting one band.fk path per case: fkwu returned the previously cached compile. Re-run with a distinct file per case, all four arms agree. Recorded because the same stale-cache shape has masked a real bug before.

ci_validation.summary: The base branch (main d1a7a53) fails Thread Gates with 8 pre-existing form-cli Exec-format failures; this branch adds none.

deploy_validation.summary: Not deployed. app.hati.earth still needs a DNS record; the Traefik router labels are in the diff.

e2e_validation.expected_behavior_delta: A hub manager types an amount in thousands and the ledger records exact whole rupiah computed by the Form kernel; a stored shop within ~150m fills the description in from GPS; entries mirror to a sheet the hub owns via a keystore-held webhook URL, with CSV export as the door out.
test_flows: resident records a spend at a pinned shop's coordinates; the shop's default_description becomes the entry's description and amount_idr is 123500 for typed '123.5'
resident records 4km from any shop; nearest returns null, a category icon plus a custom note carries the description, 0.25 records as 250 IDR
see-only member is refused a write (403) but may read the ledger (200)
zero and an unknown category are refused (422) rather than guessed
export.csv columns match the Sheets mirror columns exactly

phase_gate.reason: Band is four-way and the flow suite is green against a live fkwu. Still open: app.hati.earth DNS, the hub's sheet webhook in the keystore, and the base branch's own Thread Gates failure.
